avis.texte: I love the cooling sensation of this mask and it makes my skin like glass.

The freshness in your skin calms down your stress and you have a super glow after you remove it. Your skin looks with an extra glow and so soft that I can't even explain. I recommend you to add this mask at least 2 times a week in your skincare routine, you will not complain at all.

Loved this product. Left my skin glowing and feeling extremely refreshed. I would definitely recommend the product to friends and family if you want a clean ingredient product that does its job well. Packaging is also sleek and discreet. I would say it's worth the investment given how much you get out of it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely loved using this face mask. It helped my skin feel so cool, clean and refreshed. I also think my pores looked smaller after using it, no crazy scents aside from the ingredients and the mask is purple!!! I followed up with a moisturizer and my skin truly looks better after using. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy the feeling of this mask on my face, it's very cooling and fresh. The mask tightens as it dries down but is not a peel off. However, my skins feels more tight after rinsing it off, and I look radiant. Packaging is great, I prefer a squeeze tube instead of a pot, and you get a lot for the money.

avis.titre: A must try for oily clogged skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture of this mask is creamy and luxurious, with a lovely lavender color. Upon application, it has a cooling, tingling effect that indicates it's working its magic. As it dries, it deeply cleans out pores, leaving my skin looking smooth and poreless. The value is excellent, given its effectiveness. The product comes in a convenient, easy-to-use squeeze tube that makes application a breeze. The scent is a refreshing, earthy aroma that's calming and grounding. After rinsing, my skin feels refreshed, revitalized, and noticeably smoother. I highly recommend this mask for anyone seeking a deep cleanse and a spa-like experience at home. It's perfect for minimizing pores and achieving a radiant glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I seriously think this is one of the top pore masks on the market. After the 15 minutes of applying, I washed it off and I was shocked. It was notable that my pores were tight and I looked clarified. This definitely does wonders! As for consistency, it's like clay and dries very fast, so you got to get to work as soon as you squeeze it out!
